instruction: Find a one-way flight for two adults from Brussels to Lisbon, departing on the 25th of next month.

metadata.explanation: Task variation: One way flight search from Brussels (CRL) to Lisbon (LIS) for 2 adults departing on 25th of next month. Uses same evaluator pattern as original - parses URL parameters to verify search criteria. No custom functions needed.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: All instruction requirements are verified (origin Brussels/CRL, destination Lisbon/LIS, 2 adults, 0 teens/children, one-way flight, departure date 25th next month)
Correct getter logic: get_active_tab_url_parse correctly extracts URL query parameters from Ryanair flight search URL using urlparse and parse_qs
Correct metric logic: check_direct_json_object performs accurate key-by-key comparison of extracted vs expected values
Accurate expected values: CRL and LIS are correct IATA codes, passenger counts match instruction, isReturn='false' correctly represents one-way flight
Proper time handling: get_rule_relativeTime correctly calculates '25th next month' and formats date as YYYY-MM-DD
State accessibility: Active tab URL is reliably accessible via accessibility tree, URL parameters persist after search
